item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed. Erdoğan’s 2024 record shows real course correction in a few high-salience areas: macro stabilization, some foreign-policy bargaining, and earthquake reconstruction. But when tactics failed in political-control or scrutiny-sensitive domains, the pattern was more often coercive substitution, opacity, or suppression than genuine adaptation.

**Accepted Claims**
| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Turkey's Erdogan says party to self-critique after local election losses | The Straits Times / Reuters | 2024-04-01 | [link](https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/turkeys-erdogan-says-party-to-self-critique-after-local-election-losses) | After the local-election defeat, Erdoğan publicly said the alliance had missed its target and would do self-criticism and address shortcomings. That is direct evidence of tactical acknowledgement and some willingness to adjust. | 8B.8, 8B.7 |
| Positive | Turkey's Erdogan signs off on Sweden's NATO membership ratification | Reuters | 2024-01-25 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-signs-off-on-swedens-nato-membership-ratification-3283398) | After a long delay, Erdoğan ratified Sweden’s NATO accession, ending a stalled dispute. This shows he could drop obstruction once it stopped serving the broader bargaining line. | 8B.8, 8B.7 |
| Positive | Turkey central bank chief quits, citing need to protect her family | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-02 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/turkey-central-bank-chief-resigns-after-aggressive-rate-hikes-3291652) | When the governor resigned, Erdoğan immediately replaced her with Fatih Karahan, a technocrat expected to continue tight policy. That is clear replace-the-implementer behavior after a failed or unstable setup. | 8B.8, 8B.6 |
| Positive | Turkiye: 2024 Article IV Mission Press Release | IMF | 2024-08-28 | [link](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/08/28/pr24311-turkiye-2024-article-iv-mission-press-release) | IMF staff said the post-2023 policy turnaround tightened the policy mix, reduced crisis risks, raised confidence, improved reserves, and began easing inflation. This is strong evidence that the corrected macro line was taking effect. | 8B.8, 8B.7 |

This supports continued course adjustment rather than slogan-only governance. | 8B.8, 8B.6, 8B.7 |

This is concrete reallocation of resources toward a damaged region, not just rhetoric. | 8B.8, 8B.7 |

This is a real tactical adjustment after pushback, not pure rigidity. | 8B.8, 8B.6 |

That points to doubling down on coercion when the tactic became controversial. | 8B.8, 8B.6 |

That is not course correction; it is replacing an adverse political outcome with central coercion. | 8B.8, 8B.6 |

This looks like a badly corrected recovery policy that generated new harm. | 8B.8, 8B.7 |

**Search Gap**
I did not find a single source that directly tracks “failed tactic -> adjusted method -> improved outcome” across Erdoğan’s whole 2024 state apparatus. The evidence is fragmented by domain: macroeconomics shows real adaptation, disaster reconstruction shows mixed follow-through, and political-control episodes show much weaker correction and more coercion.
